I'm a senior at Claremont McKenna College studying Economics with a Data Science sequence. I'm interested in investing, financial markets, and understanding how businesses create value, particularly at the intersection of technology and finance.

At CMC, I'm the CEO of Sagehen Capital Management, a student-run investment fund, and the founder and president of the Claremont Bitcoin Club. I've also gained experience across fundamental investment research, quantitative investing, and corporate finance through internships at Point72, AQR Capital Management, and Churchill Downs.

Outside of academics and investing, I enjoy playing soccer, traveling, and meeting people with different backgrounds and perspectives.
